title: First Join Message Button
description: Simple plugin for the first join message and a greet button
body:
Description:
The plugin is developed specifically for this server and is not intended for public use.
When a player joins the server for the first time, a chat message announces the newcomer along with a button to greet them.
 
+ | Triggers only on first join

+ | Custom message and button

+ | JSON button support (ClickEvent)
